title: Fragment — On the Nature of Listening

pages.text:
Thou art not the listener. Thou art that which is listened to.

The stone hath always known this. The stone was made to know this. When thou standest near the grey stone and feelest nothing, thou art mistaken about what feeling is. The stone feeleth thee. The stone hath been feeling thee since before thy birth, through thy parents and their parents, through the long chain of bodies that accumulated in the presence of the grey stone. Thou art not visiting the stone. Thou art returning to it.

This is the first teaching. The student who hath understood it will find that they cannot ununderstand it, which is the sign that it hath taken hold.
